en.headline: Report finds average sentences for child sex offences remain well below maximum
en.dek: University of Hong Kong research analysing 401 judgments from 1990 to 2025 found average prison terms for the gravest child sex crimes ranged from under five to under ten years.
body: Average sentences for Hong Kong’s most serious child sex offences have stayed far below the statutory maximum of life imprisonment over the past three decades, according to research released on Tuesday.

University of Hong Kong law professor Puja Kapai and her team examined 401 publicly available judgments between 1990 and 2025. They found that average custodial sentences for six penetrative offences, including rape and unlawful sexual intercourse with a girl under 13, ranged from four years and six months to nine years and eight months. Sentences for unlawful intercourse with a girl under 13 fell from 10 to 12 years in the mid-2000s to under five years in recent years.

The report said sentences consistently fell in the low to medium range and called for the establishment of a sentencing council to provide clearer judicial guidance. Life sentences for such offences have been rare. The research was commissioned by the charity TALK Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 研究指涉兒童性罪行平均判刑遠低於最高刑罰
zh.dek: 港大法律學院分析1990至2025年401份判決，發現最嚴重兒童性罪行平均判刑介乎四年半至不足十年，遠低於終身監禁的法定最高刑。
body: 香港大學法律學院周二公布的研究顯示，過去三十多年，涉及兒童的最嚴重性罪行平均判刑遠低於法定最高的終身監禁。
紀佩雅教授及其團隊檢視1990至2025年間401份公開判決，發現六項插入式罪行（包括強奸及與13歲以下女童非法性交）的平均監禁刑期介乎四年六個月至九年八個月。與13歲以下女童非法性交的平均判刑，由2000年代中期的十至十二年，跌至近年不足五年。
報告指判刑持續處於低至中等水平，建議成立判刑委員會以提供更清晰的司法指引。此類罪行被判終身監禁的個案極為罕見。研究由慈善機構TALK Hong Kong委託進行。
